v.title: Gordon’s Ruthless Drive: A New Era for Barça’s Striker
v.excerpt: Anthony Gordon vows to be more ruthless, aiming to boost Barcelona’s attack and his own goal tally.
v.body:
## Quick take
Anthony Gordon is now calling for a more ruthless style, after netting three goals in 13 appearances for Barcelona. The forward’s ambition signals a shift in his mindset and a potential boost for Barça’s attacking threat.

## What happened
Gordon’s recent interview with the BBC revealed a clear desire to become a more ruthless scorer. He admitted that his first season in the club was about learning the rhythm of La Liga, but now he wants to dominate the final third. The striker said he’s ready to “take risks” and push defenders to the limit.

The comments come after a mixed run of form: three goals in 13 games, a modest return compared to his explosive debut with Aston Villa. Yet the forward’s confidence has not wavered; he highlighted the support from teammates and the coaching staff. Gordon’s message is aimed at both his own improvement and at raising the squad’s overall goal‑scoring intensity.

## Why it matters
- **For Barcelona’s attack**: Gordon’s ruthless approach could unlock new tactical options for Xavi, allowing the forward to operate as a lone striker or as part of a fluid front‑line. A more aggressive striker can force the opposition to commit resources, opening spaces for the midfield.
- **For Gordon’s career**: Transitioning from a “learning” phase to a “dominating” mindset may accelerate his development into a top‑tier striker. Consistency will be key, but the psychological shift could translate into a higher goal tally.
- **For the season’s narrative**: Barcelona’s title push hinges on offensive output. A forward who can press defenders and finish decisively will add a new dimension to a squad already blessed with creative talent.

## What’s next
Watch Gordon’s performance in the upcoming El Clásico against Real Madrid. A ruthless, high‑pressure style could be the catalyst that turns a tight game into a decisive win. Pay attention to his positioning, how he reacts to defensive pressure, and whether he can convert chances against one of Spain’s toughest defenses. His next goal could be the tipping point for Barça’s campaign.

*Source: [Gordon wants to be more ruthless](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cqgm0k9xg4p7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
